experiment: E3 per-policy heat (DESK on SIMULATED torques)
prereg: design/PREREG_CANDIDATES_2026_11_28.md (section 2 E3, section 3 item 7, section 4 E3)
evidence: DESK: the build's thermal model (rl/telemetry/thermal.py via rl/analysis/thermal_ambient.py, method A, fitted at the 25 C rating room, run in a 35 C room; open air, no shell) and arithmetic, on SIMULATED drive torques from rl/demo_course.py segments (MuJoCo 3.10.0); nothing measured
rule: MEETS THE HEAT RULES AT 60 CM: C1 (hottest winding over the demo, 8 min time constant) <= 90 C and C2 (worst drive's loop RMS over its continuous rating; X4-36-L 7.5 N m, X6-60 12 N m, drive side) <= 0.80, at 35 C with today's drives (D0), on BOTH demo courses (seed0 700000 and 710000). Per-policy reading, not the study's worst-of-four criterion.
operational_readings_fixed_before_any_E3: (i) a demo course with a fallen segment does not count as meeting on that course (stricter)
(ii) demo courses run at demo_course.run's default room; C1/C2 recomputed at 35 C by policy_heat
(iii) per-drive figure = loop RMS (90 s walk + 30 s stand) over the continuous rating; walk and stand RMS beside

units.C1_c: deg C (winding, peak over the demo)
units.minutes: min (one pack's runtime on the loop)
